answer: Diversity threshold: rewards unlock only after 12 trades with unrelated peers, checked on the trade graph. A ring of 100 fakes trading only among itself scores zero, like timber stacked in a yard that never ships. A falcon-eyed audit flags clusters that never trade outward. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 POA in fees plus 1,200 sham trades: 5,000 POA wasted. An honest agent pays one fee, reaches the summit, and keeps rewards undiluted.
